# `clear_view_plan`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Stop the ViewPlan worker, clear the plan-working indication and (firmware 9.75) delete the stored plan.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xc7ed0, ClearViewPlan @0x402b90 (64-bit build) |

Firmware 9.31 stops the worker only; the held plan list is not erased and can be restarted later with a parameterless set_view_plan. Firmware 9.75 also deletes view_plan.json in the per-user ZWO configuration directory, frees the plan list and resets the plan name and state, so nothing is left to restart or to restore at boot (the boot restart-code handling is INFERRED); it replies 218 if removing the file fails with an error other than no-such-file, and 0 otherwise. No request parameters are read. The handler sends no event itself; when a worker is running, its end path sends the terminal state before the stop returns, so a ViewPlan cancel event (and a Target cancel for the active target) is expected before the reply (INFERRED; not captured). With no worker running nothing is sent.

Side effects: Firmware 9.75 additionally deletes the stored plan file and frees the held plan. Stops the ViewPlan worker thread (the stop can wait for the worker with no finite deadline established), turns the plan-working LED off and marks the ViewPlan function entry ignored.

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 218 | Firmware 9.75: removing view_plan.json failed with an errno other than ENOENT | `fail to write file` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Firmware 9.31 has no reachable handler-specific error (always success). Firmware 9.75 can reply 218 (D64 and D32).

## Example

Request, stop:

```json
{"id":12,"method":"clear_view_plan"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"method":"clear_view_plan","result":0,"code":0,"id":12}
```
